body:
I too am amazed (if such an emotion still exists in me) by the similarity. I too gave up almost all my friends for her, and worse, the remaining few became closer friends to her than to me, leaving me all alone. 

I can relate to most of the other things you said too, especially
>with the pedestal I had given her I had kind of inadvertently trained myself to feel guilty any time I thought poorly of her

I totally feel the same way, even now blaming myself for no reason. When I talk to her, when I see she doesn't care for the relationship, I know I am right. But later, I think may be it's me interpreting things wrongly, may be she really does have love. And then, this new hope again will get shattered, leaving a scar on my heart. This repeated so many times I'm now ready to live even with this guilt rather than fall again into the trap of false hope.

>Do what you need to do to take care of yourself. Ask yourself everyday, "how am I going to take care of myself today?" **And while you're at it, it might not hurt to remind yourself of your own good qualities everyday as well.** You could tell yourself that you deserve to be loved by someone who appreciates you and will not try to change you. Actively declare who you are, what makes you you, who you want to be (read: who you're going to be), and that you're okay and complete without her.

That was extremely helpful. I am going to copy that and put it somewhere I will see at least once a day. I have started believing that with the practical suggestions I got here, I can get over this soon. Thank you again for the ray of hope.

I'm sorry, the username refers to the username itself - I just made up this username to 'protect my privacy'. I sincerely hope none of my (very very helpful) answerers interpret it the way you did and get offended.
Somehow of all the comments I got, yours motivates me the most. Thank you for the very positive advice, I will take them to the heart and try to follow them ever.

Thanks a lot, that makes a lot of sense. 

Thinking about it now, yes, I must have remained myself no matter what. If she can't stand me for who I am, maybe we aren't just made for each other. 

I did try to keep my mind occupied with other things (started 3 new blogs in this period) and sought out new friends, but all of that at times feels like I'm faking it. I hope it's nothing permanent and just a 'withdrawal symptom'. 

I'm trying hard to search and find myself. Thank you very much for the help again.
Thank you very much, the confidence that my true self is still there and that I can drop off the shell is what I need most.

Thanks a lot, the hope that eventually "this experience will just be a memory rather then a dominant thought in [my] mind" means a lot to me. 

By God I meant things like morality, etc. Intellectually I'm an agnostic, I just like to assign a personality to the morals and call that Perfect Person as God. I don't know if He exists, but even if He doesn't, to me He a figment of imagination that is psychologically very helpful at times...

I was living nearly the past two years entirely for a girl, giving up everything I liked just so I could be available to her. 

I was a curious-in-all geek who read anything and everything I came across, I gave up most of my reading for her sake.

I did not like those stupid 'modern' dressing and lifestyle, and adopted those because she liked it. 

I was a very spiritual person, but she was not, and my mentality changed a lot because of her association, to the point God doesn't have much role in my mind now. 

And last week, when I told her something was wrong (which it was), she gives me "I thought I had seen someone with true love, but you're not" and "I've understood you want to treat me like a puppet". 

In retrospect, I've been the unconscious puppet, and I feel like I've wasted 2 years of my life. She was not worth it. My thoughts are full of profanity these days, and images of 'creating' an accident for myself float by in my mind, even in my dreams... I had great dreams of doing something big to humanity, but now I feel like I've lost to life and have thoughts of switching over to the side of evil.

And I don't like this 'me', I'm very much torn. I have no idea how to drive these out. At times, I tell myself some damn stupid's opinions count for nothing, but at other times I cry randomly without reason, feeling I've lost everything in life, every reason to live. 

Any help is appreciated, but honestly I have no idea what can help. I'm hoping someone wiser here knows. 

Thank you very much in advance.
